title: ProBuild Tier Benefits Matrix for Other Ridgeline Programs
content:
A Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards tier carries benefits in other Ridgeline programs: a discount on Ridgeline Tool Rental rental time, a waiver of the restocking fee on returnable special orders with Ridgeline Special Order Services, a discount on Ridgeline Orders & Delivery delivery fees, and, at the upper tiers, a dedicated pro account representative.

| Tier | Discount on Ridgeline Tool Rental rental time | Restocking fee waived on returnable special orders | Discount on Ridgeline Orders & Delivery delivery fees | Dedicated pro account representative |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 0 percent | No | 0 percent | No |
| ProBuild Bronze | 0 percent | No | 0 percent | No |
| ProBuild Silver | 5 percent | No | 25 percent | No |
| ProBuild Gold | 10 percent | Yes | 50 percent | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum | 15 percent | Yes | 100 percent | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 20 percent | Yes | 100 percent | Yes |

## Points of reading

- ProBuild Member and ProBuild Bronze carry none of these four benefits.
- The restocking fee waiver and the dedicated pro account representative begin at ProBuild Gold and continue at every tier above it.
- The rental discount rises by 5 percentage points per tier from ProBuild Silver (5 percent) to ProBuild Platinum Elite (20 percent); the delivery discount is 25 percent at ProBuild Silver, 50 percent at ProBuild Gold and 100 percent at the two highest tiers.
